description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana Ihalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420350 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
